title: FizzMoss Labs
text:
FizzMoss Labs

notes:
Initial inbound from indie devs (micro-startup). Self-serve signup via /signup on 2026-02-18, applied free credits. No AE outreach yet — PLG motion.

Key snippets from sign-up form and micro-interviews: 
- 'We ship a small pair-programming tool and want fast code completions, embeddings for fuzzy search, and a lightweight chat assistant in-app.'
- Founder: Samir (CTO/sole dev) - prefers minimal infra ops, cost-sensitive.
- Latency expectation: <200ms tail for short chat flows; more tolerant for embeddings indexing jobs.
- Working prototype uses OSS LLMs locally but wants hosted API for reliability and simpler billing.
- Concern: token cost spikes on heavy reformatting prompts; asked about batching and prefix caching.
- Security: SOC2 not required today, but flagged as a requirement for any paid plan in 6-12 months. No SSO today.

Behavior since signup: signed in 2026-02-18, ran test chat and embeddings on 02/20, hit 2k tokens/day peak on 03/04, dropped to 400 tokens/day most days. Requested higher context window info via support form 03/08.

Quote from quick support reply: 'Love the latency — good enough for early users. If we grow we may need reserved capacity but for now hosted API looks ideal.'

Attachments: trial usage csv (attached to portal), link to small code sample in Drive.


timeline:
2026-02-18: self-serve signup, free credits auto-applied
2026-02-20: first embeddings index created (small dataset, ~500 docs)
2026-03-04: peak test day ~2k tokens/day
2026-03-08: support question about context window and cost optimization
2026-03-09: automated health-check email opened; no AE outreach
